reason: As a BSA officer arriving cold, B shows me a labelled, operable case file next to the promise on the first screen, and tells me exactly what happens when I click 'Request a sandbox'. As the CEO, B gives me a board brief I could take into the meeting, with the no-SOC 2 and no-regulator facts in it. A is honest and well written, and its closed-alert sample fits its headline, but its proof sits below the fold and its board path is a plainer Q&A. I would change my mind if A moved its sample into the first screen and B's unsupported pricing and integration claims turned out to be false.
